headlines.title: Mitch McConnell releases health update, saying he’s not ready to return to work yet
headlines.description: Sen. Mitch McConnell’s office released a health update Monday, saying he’s still not ready to return to in-person work after his June 14 hospitalization.

headlines.title: Citing ‘common sense,’ James Comey’s team urges judge to toss seashells case
headlines.description: Attorneys for James Comey have asked a federal judge to dismiss the seashells-based prosecution of the former FBI director.

headlines.title: US-Iran Strikes Ease After Two Weeks of Constant Attacks
headlines.description: The White House is turning down the heat on Iran with no strikes reported in the Middle East after a constant barrage of attacks for the last two weeks. This comes as the Iranian Foreign Ministry said they’ve had what they describe as productive talks with the Oman government regarding the opening of the Strait of Hormuz. NBC’s Richard Engel reports for Sunday TODAY.

headlines.title: TODAY co-host opens up about husband’s battle with cancer: 'He encouraged me to keep writing’
headlines.description: TODAY co-host Sheinelle Jones opens up about writing "Through Mom's Eyes" while her husband Uche battled cancer and how she fought for her joy to return to the TODAY Show.

headlines.title: Mark Kelly: Democrats can ‘win in Maine’ with Troy Jackson, Platner ‘wasn’t vetted well enough’
headlines.description: In an exclusive interview with Meet the Press, Sen. Mark Kelly (D-Ariz.) says he believes Troy Jackson is a “strong candidate” who can beat Republican Senator Susan Collins after Jackson replaced Graham Platner on the ballot.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Sen. John Hoffman says Angie Craig sought his endorsement while he was in ICU
headlines.description: Democratic Minnesota state Sen. John Hoffman said Rep. Angie Craig, D-Minn., sought his endorsement for her Senate campaign while he was in intensive care following the June 2025 attempt on his life.

headlines.title: Mike Waltz dismisses concerns over depleted U.S. weapons stockpile amid Iran war
headlines.description: The United Nations ambassador said the U.S. has “everything that it needs” for military operations against Iran.

headlines.title: Democrats pick Troy Jackson to replace Graham Platner in must-win Maine Senate race
headlines.description: Former state Senate President Troy Jackson officially became Democrats’ Senate nominee in Maine Saturday, starting a 101-day sprint to Election Day in a nationally watched, must-win race for his party.

headlines.title: Map: How much you pay in federal and state gas taxes
headlines.description: As national gas price averages head toward $5 per gallon, one state has already suspended its gas tax, and now President Donald Trump and his Cabinet are talking about doing the same.

headlines.title: Trump orders signage warning visitors of ‘inaccurate information’ at Smithsonian
headlines.description: While he continues to seek control of the exhibits inside the Smithsonian Institution’s museums, President Donald Trump is trying a new tactic in the front yard.

headlines.title: Trump administration concedes it canceled research grants in blue states
headlines.description: The Trump administration admitted that it terminated nearly 300 federal research grants “solely because” the projects were connected to states that voted against Trump in 2024
